summary: @onereach/orest-vue3 preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertises itself as a Vue3 re-export shim (dist/index.mjs proxies globalThis.Vue3), but its package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the binary to 0755, and then execFileSyncs a sibling file math_init.js under that Bun binary. setup.mjs is itself identifier-obfuscated (variables of the form _0x488df8, _0x52943e, control-flow indirection via dispatch objects). math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS blob (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') using a string-array/rotation obfuscation scheme (constant table n7gIxM plus a WV8StW rotator). Neither the alternate runtime nor the compiled payload is required for or related to the advertised Vue3 wrapper functionality. Running `npm install` on this package therefore fetches an alternate JS runtime and executes an opaque author-supplied binary under it on the installer's machine, giving the author arbitrary code execution outside the Node-based install pipeline typical scanners inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
